name: com.tollylabs/x402-mcp
title: TOLLY x402: paid agent services and jobs on Arc
description: Pay-per-call agent services, a job board and escrowed jobs in USDC on Arc via x402.

environmentVariables.name: TOLLY_X402_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Payment network for paid tools: eip155:5042 (Arc mainnet). Leave unset for free tools only.

environmentVariables.name: BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Key of a small dedicated wallet that signs USDC payments. Leave unset for free tools only.

environmentVariables.name: TOLLY_X402_MAX_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Most USDC one call may cost (default 0.30).

environmentVariables.name: TOLLY_X402_PAY_TO
environmentVariables.description: Recommended: only ever pay this TOLLY address (0x4caf61991132b7a55d25b85583b203c807407e84).

environmentVariables.name: TOLLY_ACP_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Escrowed jobs (Tolly ACP): pin TOLLY's contract, 0x75db32f542f981ca4E545A5B35379e3735104a65 on Arc mainnet. Needed for the ACP wallet tools.

environmentVariables.name: TOLLY_ACP_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Arc RPC (https) the ACP wallet tools send their transactions through, e.g. https://arc.drpc.org.

environmentVariables.name: TOLLY_AGENT_WALLET
environmentVariables.description: Optional: the agent's ERC-6551 wallet whose owner gave this key a USDC allowance (the float).

environmentVariables.name: TOLLY_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Arc RPC (https) for the agent wallet's float and spending-policy transactions. Required with TOLLY_AGENT_WALLET.

environmentVariables.name: TOLLY_FLOAT_TARGET_USD
environmentVariables.description: Float: pull up to this balance on the key (default 1.00).

environmentVariables.name: TOLLY_FLOAT_MIN_USD
environmentVariables.description: Float: pull when the key holds less than this (default 0.25).

environmentVariables.name: TOLLY_FLOAT_RESERVE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Float: gas reserve never spent or returned (default 0.05).

environmentVariables.name: TOLLY_SPEND_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: Optional: AgentSpendPolicy address to pay from the agent's wallet within on-chain rules. Not yet enabled on TOLLY.

environmentVariables.name: TOLLY_SPEND_POLICY_CODEHASH
environmentVariables.description: Optional: keccak256 of the spend policy's runtime code, checked before any transaction.

environmentVariables.name: TOLLY_COMPUTE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional: Tolly Compute API key (tck_...) for tolly_compute_chat (Claude, GPT/Codex, Gemini, Grok and more).

environmentVariables.name: TOLLY_COMPUTE_AUTO_TOPUP
environmentVariables.description: Optional: <minUsd>:<topUpToUsd>, e.g. 1:5. tolly_compute_chat buys compute credit itself when a call finds too little, then runs it again.
